messages:
maya: Quick sync — need a decision on how we handle ephemeral inference logs for SOC2 customers that also want BYOK. Two asks came in: 1) full audit retention for 1 year (legal) 2) sample-based evidence for 90 days (ops cost). How do we reconcile with BYOK key rotation and KMS export constraints? :thinking:

sam: From security: BYOK means we don't hold plaintext keys. For retention we have two primary constraints: a) we can't decrypt after customer rotates/destroys keys, b) we must prove integrity/chain-of-custody for SOC2. Sampling makes auditors nervous unless we can show deterministic sampling + tamper-evident hashes. :eyes:

zhen: Engineering note — current runtime writes transient KV caches and minimal logs to S3 (encrypted with our CMK). For BYOK we switch to envelope-wrapping with customer KEK; if customer rotates we lose ability to decrypt older blobs unless we escrow wrapped keys. Escrow opens legal/ops multiplication. Ballpark: adding key-escrow + attestation flow is ~3-4 sprints.

eli: Ops viewpoint — cost delta: full 1-year hot retention for inference traces (est. 5 TB/month across pilot customers) adds ~$Xk/mo; sampling (1%) reduces that significantly. Also need retention SLI and replay tools for evidence requests.

nina: Customer-success: two enterprise pilots (FinCorp, Healthly) want 1yr full retention for compliance. They're open to a hybrid: keep full metadata + hashed payloads that we can present as evidence, decrypt only on-demand with customer consent.

maya: Proposal draft for tradeoffs: - Default: 90-day sampled trace retention (1% deterministic per-session hash seed) - Enterprise opt-in: 1-year full retention but payloads encrypted with customer KEK and escrow token (customer-managed escrow or legal escrow) - For rotation: require KEK rotation policy and pre-rotation export handshake.

sam: Security additions: - Include Merkle-tree of daily manifests signed by Redwood KMS before handing to escrow to prove integrity - Require HSM-backed signing for long-term manifests - Add audit log that records decrypt attempts and attestation statements.

zhen: Implementation sketch: - Add metadata flag on request: `evidence_retention: {class: sampled|full, seed_id: <sha256>}` - Runtime writes two artifacts: `manifest.jsonl` (metadata + hashes) and `payloads.tar.enc` (encrypted payloads). Example YAML for config consumers: ```yaml
retention:
  default: sampled
  sampled_rate: 0.01
  enterprise:
    enabled: true
    retention_days: 365
    require_escrow: true
```

eli: Ops runbook notes: - On evidence request, we must produce manifest + signed Merkle proofs within SLA (TBD). - If KEK missing, produce signed attestation explaining missing payloads. - Need an automated pre-rotation webhook that prompts export/escrow or halts rotation.

maya: Launch criteria (candidate): - Product: policy UI/API for opt-ins and contract flags - Security: Merkle signing + rotation handshake design approved - Eng: runtime writes manifests + deterministic sampling implemented - Ops: retrieval/playback tool + incident runbook + cost estimate agreed - Legal: contract template for escrow flow

nina: Customer roll-out plan: pilot with FinCorp and Healthly for escrow flow + one consented rotation drill. Use pilot feedback to adjust sampling rate and SLAs.

sam: Blockers: - Legal needs to approve escrow wording (potentially 2–3 weeks) - HSM signing procurement / vault changes (infra ticket) - Risk: escrow custody models differ per region (EU vs US).

zhen: Rough effort: sampling + manifest write = 1 sprint. Enterprise escrow + signing + retrieval tool = 3–4 sprints. API/UI + contract + rollout = +2 sprints. Dependencies: KMS changes, HSM signing, legal.

maya: Decision request: Approve hybrid path (default sampled, enterprise opt-in full with escrow + attestation)? If yes I'll schedule RFC and stakeholder sync and assign owners. :+1: or :-1:?

nina: +1 from CS — push to pilot.

sam: +1 with security caveat: must include tamper-evidence and signed manifests.

zhen: +1 — will scope tickets after RFC.

ops-bot: Reminder: Created infra ticket INF-2029 for HSM signing and KMS escrow workflow (https://redwood.internal/INF-2029) :robot_face:

maya: Great — creating RFC and adding launch checklist to the roadmap doc. Will ping legal for escrow template. Thanks all. :rocket:
